profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
- Software engineer and chemical engineer with 10+ years of experience developing and supporting native applications in C++.
- Currently working on Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) shared code for syncing cloud documents and real-time coauthoring. Also heavily involved in telemetry data processing and CI/CD.
- Experienced in the full software development life cycle including collecting and documenting stakeholder input, software design and elaboration, construction, testing, maintenance and defect resolution on multiple code branches.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Azure Data Factory · Azure Data Lake · Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Microsoft Power BI · C++ · Microsoft Azure · Python (Programming Language) · Powershell · YAML · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: R&D Consultant (Software Engineering)
positions.description:
- Developed a model maintenance solution with the C3 AI Type System, JavaScript, and Python to detect data issues and ensure reactor models are calibrated and tuned to predict accurately. Key contributor to the product specification, overall design, data model, and data ingestion pipeline using Rest API.
- Designed and developed a feature in C++ to validate input data and model results which assists customers by quickly pinpointing potential sources of failure or poor model performance. Implemented at a high level in the software such that all objects/models in a flowsheet can leverage their own instance of this customizable feature.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Resolved usability issues and reduced related support requests by planning and implementing multiple usability revamp projects in C++ including reorganization of views, adding mechanisms for alternative inputs and defaults, and an automated approach to migrate models to the latest recommended options and tuning.
- Added support for additional reactor configurations, troubleshooting values for the model and reactor, and monitoring additional constraints by adding new calculations and results in Fortran. These included a new feed injection point, heat balance report, velocities at various points in the reactor, and miscellaneous results.
- Improved model performance with new feeds and catalysts by deriving kinetic parameters and model factors from pilot plant data and literature. Implemented and tested improvements against commercial data.
- Upgraded model calibration technology to match input data more accurately in Fortran.
- Fixed and protected against certain types of bugs, improved readability, and boosted effectiveness of future development by completing a project to modernize Fortran code.
- Tested and improved parallelized optimization performance for faster convergence of the flowsheet optimizer in C++. Cognizant of reliability and computational efficiency during design and development.
- Perform automated and exploratory testing to validate changes to the software and in advance of releases.
- Assist the Software Support and Consulting groups including training and mentoring support staff as well as occasionally working directly with clients. Trained and mentored 2 software development interns.

positions.title: Software Technical Support Engineer (Part-Time Software Engineering)
positions.description:
- Provided software support to clients worldwide as well as for internal consultants primarily on the use of FCC-SIM and Petro-SIM. Handled support requests on topics including usability, best practices, and details of model technology.
- Worked part-time on software development in C++ and Fortran including debugging for second line support and defect resolution as well as new feature elaboration and construction.
- Implemented FCC Unit Monitoring Tools (UMTs) used to track key performance indicators such as yields, product properties, and operating variables. These UMTs also track model performance by comparing actual and predicted values. Analyzed historical data to discard or make assumptions about poor quality data and automate this process in scripts as well as perform model tuning to improve predictive performance.
- Delivered software training and onsite implementation visits globally.
- Provided technical sales demonstrations to potential buyers of FCC-SIM and Petro-SIM.

positions.description: - Developed database management and reporting tools in Microsoft Excel using VBA to generate SQL queries.

Served as a mentor to provide homework help.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Researcher in the Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Laboratory. 
- Studied the plasma hydrogenation of graphene (single layer of graphite).
- Researched effects of electron irradiation on thinning of graphite produced by chemical vapor deposition. 
- Co-authored two published articles in scientific journals.
